metadata.description: Demo subset of the iteration-4 Step-0 knob table (art_sV0cQ3ef1ZRQ): 99 artifact x task x arm x dial cells, each carrying its recorded knob-table values and the labelled program rows (label, template, attempted, passed, catalogue/default flags) they were computed from.

groups.note: connected components: exp13 bf16 random directions rand1-3, their HF twin, the modal ban and its vLLM twin
merge intervals (immovable): exp13 random directions, HF twin, modal ban and vLLM twin
top-k frequent (immovable; modal ban Hill 1.78 at 17 pts): exp13 random directions, twins, modal ban
k-th smallest: exp13 rand1-3 + exp17 RAND90xx directions at alpha 1 and 2, both twins, the modal ban
path search: exp17 RAND90xx directions at alpha 1 and 2 and their twin; exp9 single BFS ban and its baseline

path search: temperature x sampler grid, context seeds, creativity instructions, generate-then-select, top-k / list bans, decommitment and random steering, token vetoes, 2,000-word novelty instruction
k-th smallest: novelty instruction, nonce ban and one-shot token veto (exp13)

conventions.H1r25: correct-only, mechanism-labelled Hill-1 rarefied to depth 25 (1,000 subsamples); 90% percentile bootstrap (1,000 x 200), template clusters when 5 templates have >= 5 correct programs, iid interval beside it; seeds sha256('20261021|cell')

frozen_screen.escape_rule: escape(d,t,a): offdef(d)-offdef(twin) >= 0.20 and pass(d) >= 0.8*pass(twin); offdef = 1 - n_default/n_attempted; pass = n_passed/n (no-code rows fail)
